title: Text extraction follows document order

source.clause: §5.1.5 ("the order of the submessages field is significant")
source.note: composed: the first submessage's text comes first, then every text submessage in the order it arrived, joined by single spaces. Non-text submessages are skipped and the language is not filtered — a French submessage is text too.

expect.text: What is Ecma? Qu'est-ce qu'Ecma? Please answer in both.

notes: The join is a single space even where the pieces are separate sentences; extraction is not formatting.
